factual_methodology.summary: Cross-referenced dated family archive, scholarly institutional history, and government/court documentary sources; authority distinguished from ownership and contracts.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Independent financial biography on bank partnerships, state contracts, credit and political leverage, with limitations on financial totals and conspiratorial claims.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two bilingual-parallel analytical quantitative charts with distinct measurement caveats, historical chronology, causal flow and geographic evidence map.

research_depth.summary: 11 analytic chapters, 8 linked references over 6 domain names.

evidence_traceability.summary: Cross-locale source URLs identical and linked numerals in prose; ownership or power claims limited to documented mandates.

counterfactual_review.summary: Rejects unverified dynastic continuous corporate control and tests banking risk, repayment and institutional authority alternatives.

limitations: Surviving accounting ledgers do not establish a modern consolidated net worth
Contractual access does not prove unlimited political control
notes: Approved revision 2 from Git stage blobs, distinct from completed build or external deploy.
